```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# SETUP

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ==============================================================================

library(here)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)
library(reshape2)

# Create directories (relative to project root)
dir.create(here("results"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(here("figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Project root:", here(), "\n")

# Load dataset (from WSL path)
load("//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/nkiruka/microbiome_project/data/HMPv13.rda")

ps <- HMPv13
ps
```
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# DATA EXPLORATION
# ==============================================================================

# Number of taxa (microbial features)
ntaxa(ps)

# Number of samples
nsamples(ps)

# Metadata variables
sample_variables(ps)

# Taxonomic levels
rank_names(ps)
```
```{r}
# Identify body site variable
sample_variables(ps)

table(sample_data(ps)$body_site)
```
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# EXTRACT COMPONENTS
# ==============================================================================

# OTU table (taxa x samples)
otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps))

# Metadata
metadata <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))

# Ensure orientation is correct (samples should be rows)
otu <- t(otu)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 4. CHECK DIMENSIONS
# ==============================================================================

cat("OTU table:", dim(otu), "\n")
cat("Metadata:", dim(metadata), "\n")
```
```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# MATCH SAMPLE IDs
# ==============================================================================

common_samples <- intersect(rownames(otu), rownames(metadata))

otu <- otu[common_samples, ]
metadata <- metadata[common_samples, ]

# ==============================================================================
# SELECT BODY SITE VARIABLE 
# ==============================================================================

metadata$Site <- metadata$body_site   # standardized variable

# ==============================================================================
# FILTER LOW-ABUNDANCE TAXA
# ==============================================================================

# Remove taxa with very low counts across all samples
otu_filtered <- otu[, colSums(otu) > 10]

# WHY:
# - Removes noise
# - Reduces dimensionality
# - Improves clustering stability

# ==============================================================================
# NORMALIZATION (RELATIVE ABUNDANCE)
# ==============================================================================

otu_rel <- sweep(otu_filtered, 1, rowSums(otu_filtered), FUN = "/")

# WHY:
# - Samples have different sequencing depth
# - We care about proportions, not raw counts

# ==============================================================================
# LOG TRANSFORMATION 
# ==============================================================================

otu_log <- log1p(otu_rel)

# WHY:
# - Microbiome data is highly skewed
# - Log stabilizes variance

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE OUTPUT
# ==============================================================================

saveRDS(otu_log, here("results", "otu_processed.rds"))
saveRDS(metadata, here("results", "metadata.rds"))

cat("✓ Saved to results/\n")
cat("✓ Data preprocessing complete!\n")
cat("✓ Processed data saved to results/\n")
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# PCoA ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================

otu <- readRDS(here("results", "otu_processed.rds"))
metadata <- readRDS(here("results", "metadata.rds"))

cat("Loaded OTU data:", dim(otu), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# DISTANCE MATRIX
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nComputing Bray-Curtis distance matrix...\n")
cat("(This may take 1-2 minutes for large datasets)\n")

# Add progress reporting
bray_dist <- vegdist(otu, method = "bray")

cat("✓ Distance matrix computed!\n")

saveRDS(bray_dist, here("results", "bray_curtis.rds"))

cat("✓ Saved to results/\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PCoA
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nPerforming PCoA...\n")

pcoa <- cmdscale(bray_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)

pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points)

# Save PCoA coordinates
write.csv(pcoa_df,
          here("results", "pcoa_coordinates.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE)

cat("✓ PCoA coordinates saved to results/pcoa_coordinates.csv\n")

colnames(pcoa_df) <- c("PCo1", "PCo2")

pcoa_df$Site <- metadata$Site

# Calculate variance explained
eigenvalues <- pcoa$eig
var_explained <- (eigenvalues / sum(eigenvalues)) * 100

cat("Variance explained:\n")
cat("  PCo1:", round(var_explained[1], 2), "%\n")
cat("  PCo2:", round(var_explained[2], 2), "%\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PLOT
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nCreating plot...\n")

p <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCo1, y = PCo2, color = Site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA (Bray-Curtis Distance)",
    x = paste0("PCo1 (", round(var_explained[1], 2), "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PCo2 (", round(var_explained[2], 2), "% variance)"),
    color = "Body Site"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p)

cat("✓ Plot created!\n")

ggsave(here("figures", "pcoa_plot.png"), p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("✓ Plot saved to figures/pcoa_plot.png\n")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# CLUSTERING ANALYSIS 
# ==============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(here)

cat("\n=== CLUSTERING ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Load data
metadata <- readRDS(here("results", "metadata.rds"))
metadata <- as.data.frame(metadata)

bray_dist <- readRDS(here("results", "bray_curtis.rds"))
pcoa_df <- read.csv(here("results", "pcoa_coordinates.csv"), row.names = 1)

colnames(pcoa_df) <- c("PCo1", "PCo2")

# Align metadata
metadata_sub <- metadata[match(rownames(pcoa_df), metadata$X.SampleID), ]
pcoa_df$body_site <- metadata_sub$body_site

if (any(is.na(pcoa_df$body_site))) {
  stop("❌ Metadata alignment failed!")
}

cat("✓ Data loaded and aligned\n")

# ==============================================================================
# HIERARCHICAL CLUSTERING 
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n--- Hierarchical Clustering ---\n")

hclust_result <- hclust(bray_dist, method = "ward.D2")

k <- length(unique(pcoa_df$body_site))
hclust_clusters <- cutree(hclust_result, k = k)

pcoa_df$cluster <- as.factor(hclust_clusters)

cat("✓ Clustering complete\n")

# ==============================================================================
# CONFUSION MATRIX 
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix ---\n")

confusion_matrix <- table(pcoa_df$cluster, pcoa_df$body_site)

print(confusion_matrix)

# ==============================================================================
# CLUSTER PLOT 
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n--- Plotting clustering results ---\n")

p_cluster_simple <- ggplot(pcoa_df,
                           aes(x = PCo1, y = PCo2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Hierarchical Clustering Results on PCoA",
    subtitle = "Samples colored by cluster assignment",
    x = "PCo1",
    y = "PCo2",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "lightgray", size = 0.3)
  )

print(p_cluster_simple)

ggsave(here("figures", "clustering_clusters_only.png"),
       p_cluster_simple, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("✓ Plot saved\n")

# ==============================================================================
# VISUALIZATIONS 
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n--- Creating improved clustering visualizations ---\n")

# VISUALIZATION 1: CONFUSION MATRIX HEATMAP
confusion_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(confusion_matrix))
colnames(confusion_df) <- c("Cluster", "BodySite", "Count")

p_confusion <- ggplot(confusion_df, aes(x = Cluster, y = BodySite, fill = Count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), color = "black", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrix: Clustering vs Body Sites",
    subtitle = "Numbers show how many samples from each body site fell into each cluster",
    x = "Cluster Assignment",
    y = "Actual Body Site",
    fill = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p_confusion)

ggsave(here("figures", "confusion_matrix_heatmap.png"),
       p_confusion, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

cat("✓ Confusion matrix heatmap saved\n")

# VISUALIZATION 2: CLUSTER SIZE DISTRIBUTION

cluster_sizes <- data.frame(
  Cluster = names(table(pcoa_df$cluster)),
  Size = as.numeric(table(pcoa_df$cluster))
)

# Fix alphabetical ordering issue
cluster_sizes$Cluster <- factor(cluster_sizes$Cluster, 
                                levels = as.character(1:15))

p_cluster_size <- ggplot(cluster_sizes, aes(x = Cluster, y = Size, fill = Cluster)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Size), vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster Size Distribution",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Number of Samples",
    fill = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_cluster_size)

ggsave(here("figures", "cluster_size_distribution.png"),
       p_cluster_size, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("✓ Cluster size plot saved\n")


# VISUALIZATION 3: BODY SITE REPRESENTATION BY CLUSTER
body_site_by_cluster <- as.data.frame(confusion_matrix)
colnames(body_site_by_cluster) <- c("Cluster", "BodySite", "Count")

p_composition <- ggplot(body_site_by_cluster, 
                        aes(x = Cluster, y = Count, fill = BodySite)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Body Site Composition by Cluster",
    subtitle = "Shows which body sites are represented in each cluster",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Number of Samples",
    fill = "Body Site"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_flip()

print(p_composition)

ggsave(here("figures", "body_site_by_cluster.png"),
       p_composition, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("✓ Body site composition plot saved\n")

# VISUALIZATION 4: CLUSTERING QUALITY METRIC
clustering_quality <- data.frame()

for (site in unique(pcoa_df$body_site)) {
  site_samples <- pcoa_df[pcoa_df$body_site == site, ]
  best_cluster <- names(sort(table(site_samples$cluster), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  purity <- sum(site_samples$cluster == best_cluster) / nrow(site_samples)
  
  clustering_quality <- rbind(clustering_quality, 
                              data.frame(BodySite = site, 
                                       Purity = purity * 100,
                                       BestCluster = best_cluster))
}

p_quality <- ggplot(clustering_quality, 
                    aes(x = reorder(BodySite, Purity), y = Purity, fill = Purity)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Purity, 1), "%")), 
            vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FF6B6B", high = "#4ECDC4") +
  labs(
    title = "Clustering Purity by Body Site",
    subtitle = "Percentage of each body site that clusters together",
    x = "Body Site",
    y = "Purity (%)",
    fill = "Purity"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 105) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_quality)

ggsave(here("figures", "clustering_purity.png"),
       p_quality, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("✓ Clustering purity plot saved\n")

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

clustering_summary <- data.frame(
  SampleID = rownames(pcoa_df),
  body_site = pcoa_df$body_site,
  cluster = pcoa_df$cluster
)

write.csv(clustering_summary,
          here("results", "clustering_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(as.data.frame(confusion_matrix),
          here("results", "confusion_matrix.csv"))

write.csv(clustering_quality,
          here("results", "clustering_quality_metrics.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n✓ All results saved!\n")

# ==============================================================================
# END
# ==============================================================================
```
